Applying the principle of severability, on striking down the expression 'adult male', the rest of the Section is left intact and can be enforced to achieve the object of the legislation without the offending words - The proviso to s.2(q) . has been provided only to carve out an exception to a situation .of 'respondent' not being an 'adult male',... Once 'adult male' is struck down, the proviso has no independent existence, having been rendered otiose - Constitution of India - Art. · 14 - Doctrine of severability.
